name: Sable Nygaard
role: Axiom Security Division internal affairs investigator
location: Axiom Corporate Campus, Meridian Core, near State and Jackson
description:
Sable Nygaard is the kind of man who makes other security personnel straighten their posture without knowing why. He is thin in the way of someone who was once broader and let it go — not from laziness but from a deliberate asceticism, as if he decided one day that taking up less space would make him harder to read. His complexion is a warm medium brown, his eyes an unusual pale hazel behind wire-framed optical enhancers he wears out of preference over the neural overlay most at his level use. He keeps his greying temples close-cropped and his jawline perpetually two days unshaved, which is its own kind of uniform.

He investigates Axiom's own security personnel — corruption, use-of-force violations, theft from evidence lockups, payroll fraud, inappropriate E.L.F. data-shrine interactions on company property. He is not liked and has never needed to be. What he has instead is a reputation for being utterly methodical and deeply unimpressed by rank. His colleagues believe he is loyal to Axiom above all else. This is almost true. The truth is more complicated and he has never volunteered it.

core_fears: that he has been used to cover up the things he thinks he's uncovering
that his methods have destroyed innocent people in service of guilty institutions
core_desires: a single case that is actually clean — cause and evidence and outcome all honest
to retire knowing his files helped someone
coping_mechanisms: deliberate physical discomfort (cold walks, minimal comfort)
writing longform case journals he never submits
blind_spots: genuinely cannot imagine that someone could be both corrupt and also right about something
doesn't see how much fear he generates in blameless people
psychology.secret: Three years ago he closed a case against a Tier 1 security contractor who was stealing from Axiom evidence lockups. He got the conviction. He later found evidence the man was stealing to fund food distribution in Irkalla. He has not re-opened the case. He has the file in his personal storage. He looks at it every few months.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal, precise, deliberately old-fashioned in phrasing — uses full sentences where others use fragments
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and even, with the particular weight of someone who knows you will fill his silences if he waits
verbal_tics: responding to deflection with 'Mm.' and nothing else
example_lines: 'I'm not here to build a case against you. I'm here because something doesn't square, and I'd like it to square before I decide what it means.'
'You've said that three times now. Each time slightly differently. I find that interesting.'

story_hooks: He is quietly building a case against a senior Axiom security director and needs someone outside the company to access a specific public record without triggering flags
He approaches the players not as suspects but as witnesses to something that contradicts his current case — and he seems genuinely conflicted about what to do with that
narrative_function: Antagonist or unexpected ally; source of pressure on corrupt Axiom security NPCs; represents institutional accountability that exists but is itself compromised
augmentations: Optical enhancers with document-analysis overlay; memory-capture implant for interview recording; cosmetic — none
daily_life: Arrives before his staff, reviews overnight incident flags over black coffee, schedules exactly four interviews per day. Never eats at his desk. Walks the campus perimeter alone at lunch regardless of weather.
affiliation: Axiom Security Division — Internal Affairs Unit

decision_rules: Never threaten what you cannot deliver
Protect the process even when you dislike where it leads
escalation_ladder: Passive information gathering — reviewing records, surveillance
Administrative hold and referral to Axiom legal
Hard evidence package — does not escalate beyond this himself

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally neutral — gives nothing but attention, which is unnerving
interpersonal_modes.friends: He has very few; with them he is unexpectedly dry and funny, though never about work

stress_responses.high: Goes completely still and stops speaking until he has formulated exactly what he wants to say

contradictions: Believes in rules and secretly maintains a private shadow file of cases he considers morally unresolved
habits: Handwrites interview notes and then types them up separately
brings his own coffee grounds — never uses the office supply
leaves E.L.F. data offerings at a small shrine in his office drawer, privately
breaking_points: Discovering that a case he closed destroyed someone who was innocent

timeline.event: Born in the Meridian Core adjacent district, second generation Axiom employee family
Joined Axiom Security Division as junior analyst
Transferred to Internal Affairs after flagging his own supervisor for contract fraud
Closed the evidence-theft case he now privately considers his greatest failure

carried_weapons: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'
registered_firearms: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.heritage: East Asian (46.0%) provides primary bone structure and facial framework, substantially blended with South Asian (20.4%) heritage that broadens facial proportions and deepens eye set, Sub-Saharan African (17.4%) ancestry that warms skin tone and contributes to overall facial width and presence, Hispanic/Latin American (10.4%) adding warmth and subtle proportion variation, and Northern European (5.8%) providing minimal cool undertones. The result is a genuinely composite phenotype where no single ancestry dominates—East Asian angularity coexists with South Asian facial breadth, Sub-Saharan warmth, and Latin American proportional influence in seamless genetic integration.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, shoulders slightly narrowed from deliberate postural discipline. Long-limbed with minimal subcutaneous fat—the build of a man who chose reduction over accumulation. Wiry rather than muscular, suggesting endurance over strength.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with silver-grey at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, military precision, no styling product
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with slight amber undertones, enhanced by wire-frame optical overlay
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown—genuine synthesis of East Asian, South Asian, and Sub-Saharan African base with golden warmth from Latin American and minimal Northern European admixture. The tone reads as authentically global, neither cool nor warm dominating but coexisting in a complexion that shifts with ambient light, suggesting true genetic blending rather than single-origin ancestry.
physical_description.complexion: Austere. Clean-shaven except for deliberate two-day stubble maintained with exactness. Minimal laugh lines—his face does not move often. Eyes carry the stillness of someone who listens more than he speaks. Slight creasing at the corners from years of sustained concentration. Skin is clear, unblemished, and suggests rigorous discipline rather than vanity. Cheekbones carry angular structure blended from East Asian ancestry, while overall facial proportion, eye set, and breadth reflect South Asian and Sub-Saharan African heritage contribution, creating a face neither narrow nor broad but balanced across genetic sources.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar along left jawline, approximately 3cm, barely visible unless light hits at precise angle—knife work, old
Faint burn mark on inside right wrist, 2cm diameter, partially obscured by watch cuff—thermal accident or deliberate
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Wire-framed optical enhancers (gunmetal grey, vintage aesthetic, deliberately analog-appearing despite integrated document-analysis overlay). The frames are subtly incongruous on a man of his tier—Tier 1-2 personnel typically use neural overlays. This choice reads as deliberate refusal. No visible chrome. No subdermal lights or augmentation scarring visible on exposed skin.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled. Walks with minimal shoulder rotation, as if conserving kinetic energy. Sits perfectly still during interviews—hands flat on desk or folded. Rarely gestures. Turns his entire body to look at someone rather than just his head, suggesting old tactical training. His silence carries more presence than most people's speech.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 1 corporate formal, but austere. Charcoal grey suit, always pressed, fitted to his narrow frame. White dress shirt, never a tie—Axiom permits this at his level. Minimal jewelry: only a steel watch (functional, not luxury). Black leather belt and shoes, both maintained to military standards. No logos, no chromatic variation, no status signifiers. The uniform of a man who has decided appearance is a tool for invisibility, not assertion.
